dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and irregular closed-loop structures present. Edges exhibit sharp light-to-dark transitions with high-contrast, jagged light-colored perimeters surrounding slightly darker or mottled interiors compared to the external dark dorsal base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-colored pixels appearing as localized specks and small irregular clusters, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A cluster of three primary macro-annuli on the upper dorsal-lateral ridge forms a non-equilateral triangle. A secondary chain of smaller annuli extends posteriorly, creating a curved linear path toward the lower back.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, large area of high-intensity, solid light pixels is visible on the anterior snout and cranial region, contrasting with the darker value of the surrounding head pixels.
